test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Samira is a lady who needs __extrinsic__ motivation and will not work on her own.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"extrinsic"** means something that is not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside. (बाहरी)

 
 
• **Example: **Their motivation for volunteering was purely extrinsic, driven by the promise of rewards.
 
 
 
• **"Outward" **refers to something that is directed towards the outside or external; relating to the external appearance or actions of a person. (बाहरी)
 
 
• **Example: **She maintained an outward calm, but inside she was very nervous.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'extrinsic'** is **'outward'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amicable** (मित्रवत): Having a spirit of friendliness; without serious disagreement or rancor.

 
 
• **Example:** They reached an amicable settlement in the dispute.
 
 
 
• **Intriguing** (दिलचस्प): Arousing one's curiosity or interest; fascinating.
 
 
• **Example: **She found the concept of time travel intriguing.
 
 
 
• **Adventurous** (साहसी): Willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.
 
 
• **Example:** He led an adventurous life, traveling to remote areas of the world.
